items.title: G7 ministers press Rubio on Ukraine and Iran in Paris
items.summary: G7 foreign ministers opened a two-day meeting in Paris, with Ukraine's foreign minister joining the Ukraine session on 10 Nov. It is Rubio's first trip abroad since Republicans lost control of Congress in the midterms, and allies are asking about postwar security guarantees.
items.why: US-Europe friction over Ukraine and Iran shapes energy prices and the outlook for European and Indian exporters.

items.title: US to mediate new Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: The United States is preparing to mediate a new round of Russia-Ukraine negotiations in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 November, according to reports from the G7 sidelines. No details of an agenda were given.
items.why: Any ceasefire progress would ease commodity and freight costs that feed into company budgets and hiring.

items.title: Rubio says 'no progress' with Iran as Hormuz plans circulate
items.summary: Rubio said there had been no progress in talks with Iran, and Trump has not ruled out new strikes on a suspected nuclear site. Separately, reports say the US has proposed a phased plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz starting with a partial lifting of its blockade, and Qatar has floated an interim deal. Details are provisional.
items.why: The Hormuz closure is the main driver of oil and fertiliser prices, which hit Indian inflation and margins.

items.title: Republican lawmaker moves to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war
items.summary: A Republican member of the US Congress moved to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war, the Times of Israel live blog reported on 9 Nov. It is not yet clear how much support the move has.
items.why: Shows how the midterm result is changing US war policy, which markets watch closely.

items.title: COP31 opens in Türkiye with electrification goal as 1.5C slips
items.summary: The UN climate summit opened in Antalya on 9 Nov, co-hosted by Türkiye and Australia, aiming for a pledge that 35 percent of world energy comes from electricity by 2035. Critics say the pledge does not require the power to be low-carbon, and the US sent no official delegation. Talks run to 20 Nov.
items.why: Climate commitments drive ESG reporting, green jobs and sustainability roles companies are hiring for.

items.title: WMO: 2026 on track to be among the four hottest years
items.summary: A World Meteorological Organization report released at COP31 says 2026 is on track to be one of the four hottest years on record, with record ocean temperatures and faster glacier melt.
items.why: Extreme heat affects workforce productivity and safety policies, a growing HR concern.

items.title: Supreme Court: government staff held over 48 hours are suspended automatically
items.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that government employees in judicial custody for more than 48 hours stand suspended automatically, without a separate order, according to Amar Ujala's live news page for 10 Nov.
items.why: A clear service-rule precedent that HR teams in the public sector and PSUs will apply.

items.title: Supreme Court upholds states' power to levy extra sales tax under pre-GST laws
items.summary: A seven-judge bench led by CJI Surya Kant held that states could levy additional sales tax under pre-GST laws. The court said GST's 2017 rollout made the question largely academic, so current GST is unaffected. Reported on 4-5 Nov.
items.why: Settles old tax disputes that sat on company balance sheets, relevant for finance and legal teams.

items.title: Farm fires rise in Punjab over Diwali; Swachh Survekshan awards on 11 Nov
items.summary: Farm fires rose across Punjab during Diwali, a daily headlines digest reports. President Droupadi Murmu is due to present the Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 cleanliness awards on 11 November.
items.why: Air quality hits attendance and productivity across north India; cities' rankings matter to employers choosing locations.

items.title: Bhai Dooj, India v New Zealand third ODI on today's calendar
items.summary: Today's major events include Bhai Dooj, a Patna visit by BJP president Nitin Nabin, and the third India-New Zealand ODI, according to Amar Ujala's day planner.
items.why: Festival week shapes retail demand and campaign timing for marketers.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty snap a seven-day rally; IT lags on AI fears
items.summary: On 9 Nov the Nifty fell about 0.36 percent to 24,897 and the Sensex about 0.38 percent to 80,691, slipping below 25,000 after a roughly 10.5 percent seven-session run. Pharma and media gained while Infosys, HCL Tech and TCS lagged on fears that AI automation will hurt their business.
items.why: IT services are the biggest campus recruiters; AI pressure on them shapes fresher hiring.

items.title: Brent falls to about $98 on Iran talk comments
items.summary: Brent crude dropped to around $98 a barrel after Trump commented on possible negotiations with Iran, market reports said on 9 Nov. Easing oil helped the recent rally in Indian stocks.
items.why: Oil is India's largest import; lower prices ease costs for FMCG and logistics firms.

items.title: Wall Street jumps over 2% as oil slides and tech rebounds
items.summary: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 rose more than 2 percent on 9 Nov as oil fell back and technology shares recovered, TheStreet reported.
items.why: Global risk appetite drives foreign flows into Indian markets and IPO windows.

items.title: PepsiCo to cut about 1,000 North American jobs
items.summary: PepsiCo plans to cut roughly 1,000 jobs across its North American food and beverage business after beverage sales fell 2 percent in the third quarter and food stayed flat.
items.why: A live case of FMCG restructuring: how demand slowdowns turn into workforce plans.

items.title: Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery merge; layoffs coming
items.summary: Skydance has completed its merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, and its leaders told staff in a memo that layoffs are coming as the company targets more than $6 billion in savings within three years.
items.why: Post-merger integration and layoffs are classic HR and change-management territory.

items.title: Fiserv and Angi cut jobs, Boeing trims about 5%
items.summary: A layoff tracker updated 9 Nov lists Fiserv cutting about 3,000 employee and contractor jobs under its new CEO and Angi cutting 300; Boeing is cutting roughly 5 percent of staff with notices from December. Figures are from trackers and may be revised.
items.why: Shows which sectors are shrinking headcount heading into 2027 planning.

items.title: Apple launches its first paid Apple Intelligence tier
items.summary: Apple has begun selling one-time $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs, starting in Logic Pro, its first paid tier for Apple Intelligence, according to aggregator reports. Pricing details vary slightly between listings.
items.why: A test of how far consumers will pay for AI features, a key pricing question for marketers.

items.title: Samsung reportedly testing a paid Galaxy AI tier
items.summary: Samsung is reportedly testing a paid Galaxy AI Premium subscription despite earlier promising that 19 features would stay free. It is not a confirmed launch.
items.why: Freemium-to-paid shifts are a live marketing and brand-trust case.

items.title: Google adds two specialised TPUs
items.summary: Google announced the TPU 8tx for secure, confidential computing in regulated industries and the 8i Max for longer context windows, Investing.com reported.
items.why: Cloud AI capacity decides what HR-tech and marketing-tech tools can do and cost.

items.title: Medium launches TK app with built-in AI writing tools
items.summary: Medium launched a new app, TK, with AI writing tools built into its publishing platform, dated 9 Nov.
items.why: Content marketing tools are adding AI drafting; useful to know for brand and employer-branding work.

items.title: Report: Google and Microsoft may get gatekeeper role over AI chips
items.summary: A Reuters report relayed by Seeking Alpha says the US Commerce Department could give big cloud providers such as Google and Microsoft a global gatekeeper role over access to AI chips. The report is undated in the results and unconfirmed.
items.why: Would shape which countries and firms, including Indian ones, can get AI compute.

items.title: COP31 runs 9 to 20 November in Antalya
items.summary: The summit is co-hosted by Türkiye and Australia and centres on a 35 percent electrification-by-2035 pledge.
items.why: Dates to note for sustainability case discussions.

items.title: Indian stocks rose about 10.5% in seven sessions
items.summary: The Sensex and Nifty's run to 6 Nov was their longest winning streak of the year, helped by foreign buying and easing oil.
items.why: Context for market sentiment around placements season.

items.title: Skydance targets over $6 billion in merger savings
items.summary: The savings target over three years after combining with Warner Bros. Discovery explains the coming layoffs.
items.why: A number to quote in synergy and restructuring discussions.
